title: Two more Bukidnon centenarians receive P50,000 cash incentives

blocks.text: DANGCAGAN, Bukidnon — Two more living centenarians in southern Bukidnon received P50,000 each in cash incentives from the provincial government on Wednesday, November 11, as part of its continuing recognition of the province’s oldest residents. Ellen Salumintao, Provincial Social Welfare and Development Office (PSWDO) head, personally went to the homes of the beneficiaries to hand over the financial assistance. The new centenarians are Iluminada Baria Nallano of Barangay Panadtalan in Maramag, and Martina Igcaliños Quilab of Barangay Barongcot in Dangcagan.
